policy: Research-backed capability registry; optional integrations are never allowed to replace the deterministic FFmpeg/OTIO path until benchmarked and QC-verified.

capabilities.name: Bento4
capabilities.role: ISO-MP4 inspection, muxing, atom/box validation and packaging

capabilities.name: Silero VAD
capabilities.role: voice activity detection before transcription and dialogue segmentation
capabilities.license: model/code licensing must be recorded at deployment time

capabilities.name: Demucs
capabilities.role: dialogue/music/effects source separation and audio stem extraction
capabilities.license: MIT for the Demucs project; model provenance/license recorded separately

capabilities.name: MLT
capabilities.role: multitrack media engine and deterministic editorial rendering backend

capabilities.name: OpenCue
capabilities.role: production render scheduling and distributed task management

selectionRules: Prefer maintained upstream projects over abandoned forks.
Record license and model provenance before production use.
Keep every expensive analysis stage resumable and cacheable.
Never make an optional AI/model dependency a single point of failure.
Require deterministic before/after media QC for every new processing backend.
Content-address generated outputs so a backend can be swapped without invalidating evidence.
